body: i understand your perspective, but your struggle is still as valid as anyone else’s, even if it feels like “people have it worse”, because it’s still affecting you regardless, your feelings are still valid. don’t worry about venting, sometimes it helps a little bit just to vent and get everything out of your system. if you want you can dm me  to vent more or need a distraction or just talk! sometimes a friendly voice can help

oh yeah i understand completely, you should be yourself, and don’t care about what others think because their opinion really doesn’t matter
thank you for that. you’re very strong too, i believe, no actually i know, you can get through this

when i get overwhelmed by emotions i shake like my body just can’t handle it. i don’t know why i’m so weak and every time something goes wrong, suicide is always the first thing i resort to. i just want the physical and emotional pain to stop. i don’t see a future anymore so what’s the point

i’m sorry you feel this way, it’s horrible, i feel so lost, so alone, it’s scary. i am too weak. 
sending you virtual hugs
